steps.say: A root word is the main word. Prefixes and suffixes are added to it.
Words built from the same root word make a word family.
Words in a family share a meaning. You can use one word to work out another.
Careful: two words that look alike may not be in the same family.
To find the root, take off the prefix and the suffix.

check.prompt: What is the root word of replayed?

options.why: Re- is the prefix, not the root word.
Layed is not the main part of the word.

hints: Take off the prefix at the start.
Take off the ending as well.
What main word is left in the middle?
check.explanation: Re + play + ed = replayed. The root word is play.

check.prompt: Write the root word of teacher.
hints: Teacher has a suffix at the end.
The ending -er can mean a person who does something.
check.explanation: Teach + er = teacher. The root word is teach.
